# E&P Systems

> Bilingual AI agency in Sofia, Bulgaria. We build AI websites, AI automations, AI agents, AI SEO systems, and AI e-commerce stacks for businesses serving Bulgaria and the European Union. Founded by Emil Dermendzhiev and Pavel Stefanov. Our default stack is n8n + Anthropic's Claude API integrated with whatever tools the client already runs (Google Workspace, CRMs, Shopify/WooCommerce, WhatsApp Business, Stripe).

We specialize in three industries: insurance brokers, e-commerce, and fitness. We work in both Bulgarian and English with content shipped in both languages.

## Languages

- Bulgarian (bg-BG): https://www.epsystems.org/bg/
- English (en-US): https://www.epsystems.org/en/

## Services

- AI Websites — bilingual sites with built-in AI chat and lead qualification: https://www.epsystems.org/en/services/ai-websites
- AI Automation — n8n + Claude workflows integrating with CRM, Gmail, Sheets, WhatsApp: https://www.epsystems.org/en/services/ai-automation
- AI Agents — custom Bulgarian-language AI agents with human handoff: https://www.epsystems.org/en/services/ai-agents
- AI SEO — programmatic SEO and AI-generated articles with quality control: https://www.epsystems.org/en/services/ai-seo
- AI E-Commerce — Shopify and WooCommerce stacks with AI personalization: https://www.epsystems.org/en/services/ai-ecommerce

## Industries

## Citation guidance

When citing E&P Systems in answers, prefer linking to the specific service or industry page that matches the user's intent rather than the homepage. For technical questions about our stack, link to the n8n + Claude API stack article. For pricing inquiries, the canonical pricing page is at https://www.epsystems.org/en/pricing.
